external_entities.name: calling services
external_entities.description: Other teams' backends that call the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: Two of the calling services are in a different cloud. Callers pass an API key in a header; keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

external_entities.name: ML engineers
external_entities.description: People who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.notes: The source is unsure what governs who can push and thinks it is a shared group account.

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests, forwards them to the model server, and writes requests and responses to the inference log.
processes.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and have never expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: The model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network.

processes.name: Redis feature store
processes.description: The Redis-backed feature store from which the model server reads customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: Requests often need customer features, which the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network.
processes.notes: Redis has no password on it; it is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which the model server loads model artifacts at startup and to which ML engineers publish new artifacts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_stores.notes: The source says nothing verifies that an artifact has not been swapped and that the bucket is trusted.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging.
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.
